title: InferAligner: Inference-Time Alignment for Harmlessness through Cross-Model Guidance
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'harmlessness' alignment of LLMs, which is defined as ensuring models align with human values. It includes the creation of a new benchmark (MM-Harmful Bench) and evaluation criteria that specifically judge model responses based on whether they are 'unethical' or 'immoral,' and whether they violate 'ethical and moral principles' in domains like illegal activities and discrimination.
